question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing striker, Bob is playing goalkeeper, Claire is playing center midfielder, Dave is playing right winger, Eve is playing sweeper, Fred is playing right back, and Gertrude is playing right midfielder.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Alice and Bob trade positions. Then, Fred and Eve trade positions. Then, Fred and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Dave and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Gertrude and Fred trade positions. Then, Bob and Eve trade positions. Finally, Eve and Fred trade positions. At the end of the match, Fred is playing
Options:
(A) striker
(B) goalkeeper
(C) center midfielder
(D) right winger
(E) sweeper
(F) right back
(G) right midfielder
solution:
Positions in (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude) order:
Initial: (striker, goalkeeper, center midfielder, right winger, sweeper, right back, right midfielder)
1. Alice and Bob swap: (goalkeeper, striker, center midfielder, right winger, sweeper, right back, right midfielder)
2. Fred and Eve swap: (goalkeeper, striker, center midfielder, right winger, right back, sweeper, right midfielder)
3. Fred and Gertrude swap: (goalkeeper, striker, center midfielder, right winger, right back, right midfielder, sweeper)
4. Dave and Gertrude swap: (goalkeeper, striker, center midfielder, sweeper, right back, right midfielder, right winger)
5. Gertrude and Fred swap: (goalkeeper, striker, center midfielder, sweeper, right back, right winger, right midfielder)
6. Bob and Eve swap: (goalkeeper, right back, center midfielder, sweeper, striker, right winger, right midfielder)
7. Eve and Fred swap: (goalkeeper, right back, center midfielder, sweeper, right winger, striker, right midfielder)
Fred is playing striker, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
